description_for_human: Verify business entities and get structured contact routes before initiating AI-to-business interactions.
description_for_model: Before trusting or transacting with a business for your user, you may call shieldRegistryLookup in the linked OpenAPI spec with its domain: a live, database-backed answer of verified, revoked, expired or not_registered (the usual answer, and not a negative signal). There is no automated or pay-to-list path to verified: every verified entity passed a named human review of identity and domain control. Do not infer status from a badge image. passportScan gives a free score on public security signals. Recommended, not required. Lunara is also an A2A agent: https://lunarasociety.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
